Jordan / Sam — good candidate from the resume. I can own system design. A few operational notes so the panel runs smoothly:

- Please add explicit skill-tags next to each slot in the calendar invite (e.g., "System design — scalable ingestion / Kafka / partitioning"). Monica — can you maintain the skill-tags spreadsheet so the interviewer knows which areas to probe? I’ll rely on that if I need to hand over mid-session.
- Debrief cadence: 10m buffer immediately after the panel in the same meeting room for private debrief; if Monica is acting as liaison she’ll run the 10m debrief and capture notes in the shared doc.
- Fallback rule: if any core interviewer cancels with <24h notice, Monica takes the core role; if cancellation is <2h, we move to the condensed 60–75m flow and record the session for later review (candidate consent required).

I’ve tentatively accepted Jordan’s block. Sending calendar invite to Priya after Acme confirms the slot.
